notes: The Number-of-Queues negotiation is the most operationally important loop — the host requests N SQ/CQ, controller grants min(N, controller_max). MDTS drives I/O scheduler splitting. Memory Page Size is fixed at controller-enable and cannot change without Controller Reset.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Eye diagram per Lane
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify transmitter output meets Figure 4-32 minimum eye-height/width; verify receiver input meets Figure 4-34 minimum eye.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Jitter budget
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Random jitter + deterministic jitter must be within the Gen 1 budget so the BER stays below 10^-12 after CDR.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: De-emphasis level
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: ≈ -3.5 dB de-emphasis on the first symbol after a transition; verifies the transmitter's high-frequency boost.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Common-mode voltage
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: ≈ 0.5 V at TX; AC coupling means RX can have a different common mode.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Electrical Idle detect threshold
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: RX must distinguish Electrical Idle from active signaling reliably.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: REFCLK jitter + frequency
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: 100 MHz nominal; SSC modulation ≤ 0.5%; jitter budget split between transmitter PLL and reference.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: LTSSM oscilloscope decode
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Capture TS1 / TS2 / SKP / FTS / EIOS ordered sets to debug Link Training failures.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Protocol analyzer (TLP/DLLP)
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Off-the-shelf PCIe protocol analyzers (LeCroy, Keysight) tap the Link via interposers and decode all packet classes for compliance testing.

calibration_summary: NVMe Base 1.4 specifies several host-side calibration / configuration loops: (1) Memory Page Size negotiation via CC.MPS in [CAP.MPSMIN, CAP.MPSMAX]; (2) Number of Queues negotiation via Set Features FID 07h; (3) MDTS enforcement; (4) Power State negotiation; (5) Temperature Threshold. PCIe-level calibration is delegated to the underlying PCIe Base Spec.

host_negotiation_loops.name: Memory Page Size
host_negotiation_loops.purpose: Choose CC.MPS supported by both host and controller.
procedure: Pick CC.MPS in [MPSMIN, MPSMAX] matching host MMU.

host_negotiation_loops.name: Number of I/O Queues
procedure: Host shall not Create I/O queues beyond granted counts.

host_negotiation_loops.name: MDTS
procedure: MDTS=0 ⇒ no limit imposed by controller.

host_negotiation_loops.name: Temperature Threshold
procedure: Set Features FID=04h; CDW11 = TMPSEL<<20 | THSEL<<16 | TMPTH (Kelvin).
Controller generates Async Event on threshold crossing.

host_negotiation_loops.name: Power State
host_negotiation_loops.purpose: Choose a Power State from Identify Controller PSD array.
procedure: Set Features FID=02h Power Management; CDW11.PS=desired.
Enable APST via Set Features FID=0Ch if desired.

no_card_side_analog_trim: NVMe Base 1.4 exposes no analog trim / calibration register at the controller interface. Internal NAND/SCM trim, ECC margin calibration, read-retry, and wear leveling are vendor-managed.
pcie_layer_calibration_delegated: PCIe transmitter equalization, lane deskew, link training (LTSSM), and Equalization Phase 0..3 are governed by PCI Express Base Spec, not by NVMe.

vdd_ramp_characterization.supply_specification: Determined by form factor — M.2 (3.3 V), U.2 (3.3 V + 12 V), EDSFF (12 V).
vdd_ramp_characterization.host_action_after_perst: Wait for PCIe link to L0; issue PCI Configuration cycle; then NVMe bring-up.
